title: Design System: Pace
status: TARGET system — not yet shipped. Source: context/design/redesign-spec.md (direction A · Тетрадь, approved 2026-11-01). Regenerated from the shipped code at the end of the overhaul (plan Task 8.4).

large-title.purpose: Top-level screen title, same height on every destination.

headline.purpose: Group headers that are headings, emphasised row titles, period label.

body.purpose: Row titles, paragraphs, field text (task-row titles at 500).

callout.purpose: Button labels (600), secondary paragraphs, trailing values, subtitles.

subhead.purpose: Grouped-list section headers (sentence case, label-secondary), chip and segment labels.

footnote.purpose: Meta lines, field labels and messages, tooltips, key hints.

caption.purpose: Tags, tab labels, chart labels, time-bar button labels.

numeric-value.purpose: Durations, times and counts in rows.

typographyRules.family: Inter only (Latin + Cyrillic); weights 400/500/600/700; web keeps the self-hosted variable font with font-optical-sizing: auto
typographyRules.androidScaling: sp with allowFontScaling; maxFontSizeMultiplier 1.6 on chrome only

shadows.name: overlay-light
shadows.purpose: Sheets, dialogs, popovers, toasts, tooltips in light.

shadows.name: overlay-dark
shadows.purpose: The same floating layers in dark: inner hairline + deep drop.

shadows.name: card-light
shadows.purpose: Only the desktop running card; none in dark.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Focus-visible ring: 2 px with a 2 px offset following the element's radius; Highlight in forced colours.

motion.name: duration-xs
motion.purpose: Press, hover, tooltip exit, check-circle fill.

motion.name: duration-sm
motion.purpose: Fades, tooltip, segmented/switch thumb, check-off row fade, reduced-motion fade.

motion.name: duration-md
motion.purpose: Disclosure height, toast, row close-up, dialog.

motion.name: spring-thumb
motion.purpose: Switch/segmented thumb, tab indicator pill on Android.

motion.name: reduced
motion.purpose: Replaces travel and scale under prefers-reduced-motion; never 0 for a change that carries meaning.

motion.name: check-off
motion.value: circle fill 100ms enter · row fade 1→0 160ms exit · rows close up 220ms move · Undo toast 220/160
motion.purpose: Owner's choice Q2: plain fade, no dissolve, no strike-through before leaving; ≤ 300 ms total.

narrative.overview:
Pace is a school notebook used as a tool: cool squared paper, ballpoint-blue ink and a red margin rule. The ink does every interactive job (the one primary action, links, the current selection, the focus ring, done); the red margin is status only (the now-line on Day, overdue, Urgent, destructive). Everything at rest is neutral paper and graphite text, so the content (task titles, times, the day's shape) is the brightest thing on the screen.

The app works in Operate mode on every surface: the person is in the middle of a task, so scanability, consistency and platform expectations outrank expression. The world contributes type rhythm, palette, density and one signature detail; the shell, navigation and controls are the platform's (Material affordances on Android, web semantics on the web, Apple-productivity-grade craft on both). A screen is one ground with grouped list sections on it; elevation is only for things that float. Time is drawn as time: one formatter, tabular figures, proportional spans wherever a screen shows a day.

The signature lives on Day: the timeline sits on a faint 4-pt dot grid (only behind the timeline), crossed by a red now-line; the running activity reads as an ink line with a red mark at its expected length. Both themes, both scripts (Latin and Cyrillic) and the worst case (long Russian names, 1 284 tasks, font scale 1.6) are part of the design, not tests after it.
keyCharacteristics: One cool accent (ink blue) for every interactive job; red is status, never decoration.
One surface with grouped lists; separators only between rows of a group, inset to the text.
Inter only, thirteen fixed type roles, tabular figures for every number.
A 4-pt spacing scale and seven radii; nothing off-scale exists.
Depth by tonal step; shadows only on floating layers in light, a hairline in dark.
Every press answers within a frame; every overlay leaves the way it came; nothing exceeds 300 ms.

rules.name: The One Ink Rule
rules.body: Ink blue is the only interactive colour, and a screen at rest shows at most one filled ink element. On desktop the sidebar's New task button is that element, so screens keep their own actions tonal until something is ready to commit.

rules.name: The Red Margin Rule
rules.body: Red marks status: the now-line, overdue, Urgent, destructive, errors. It is never decoration, never a brand flourish, never a category.

rules.name: The Pen Colour Rule
rules.body: A category is a 1 px line (or a small dot in a value, a chip or a legend) in its hue's `stroke`, with its name in `label-*`. A project is a tag: hue `tint` fill and hue `ink` text, `rounded.sm`. «В работе» / In progress is a violet tag, because blue belongs to the ink. Importance has no colour of its own: Urgent is a red word, Priority a bold word in `label-primary` (600), Low shows no word but draws the title in `label-secondary`, Normal shows nothing.

rules.name: The Logo Lime Rule
rules.body: Lime belongs to the Pace mark, favicon and app icon. It never appears as an interface colour.

rules.name: The No Kicker Rule
rules.body: Nothing sits above a title: no eyebrow, no kicker, no small-caps date. The date is a subtitle under the large title (Now, Day) or lives in the period control (Week, History, Insights).

rules.name: The Tabular Time Rule
rules.body: Every duration, clock and count uses a numeric role (tabular figures built in) and one core formatter: Russian gets a non-breaking space before units («2 ч 05 мин», «1 284»), a decimal comma, and hours roll into days past 48 h.

rules.name: The One Section Header Rule
rules.body: A section header is `subhead`, sentence case, `label-secondary`, 24 px above and 8 px below, inset to line up with cell text, announced as a heading of its level.

rules.name: The One Surface Rule
rules.body: A screen is one ground with grouped lists on it. No cards in cards, no hairline around every container, no bordered boxes stacked in a column.

rules.name: The Notebook Grid Rule
rules.body: The dot grid exists only behind Day's timeline. It never becomes a page background, a card texture or a decoration elsewhere.

rules.name: The Float-Only Rule
rules.body: Elevation is for things that float (sheets, dialogs, popovers, toasts, tooltips). Lists, rows, groups and notices sit flat on their ground.

rules.name: The One Boundary Rule
rules.body: A hairline and a fill never both mark the same boundary. No border around cells, cards, chips at rest, tags or the composer; a 1 px `outline` appears only on a control with no fill to mark it.

rules.name: The Nested Radius Rule
rules.body: Inner radius = outer radius − padding, never below `xs`: a 16-radius group with 8 inset holds 8-radius controls.

rules.name: The Rare Pill Rule
rules.body: Pills are for chips, switches, badges, the segmented track and indicators. Tags are not pills in this world; they are `sm` rectangles, like a label written on the page.

dos: **Do** keep ink blue (#2E4AD6 / #97A9FF) as the only interactive colour, with at most one filled ink element per screen at rest.
**Do** reserve Red Margin (#C3352B / #FF8274) for the now-line, overdue, Urgent, destructive and errors.
**Do** show a category as a 1 px line or small dot in its hue `stroke` with the name in `label-*`, and a project as a `sm` tag in hue `tint` + `ink`.
**Do** put every number through a numeric role (tabular figures) and the core formatter, with non-breaking spaces in Russian.
**Do** build screens as one `bg-app` ground with `bg-cell` groups (`lg`, 16) and inset separators.
**Do** give every pressable the one state layer: `fill-1` hover, ripple `fill-3` / `fill-2` overlay, a 2 px + 2 px ink focus ring, `label-quaternary` + `fill-1` when disabled.
**Do** check every decision in both themes, in Russian, at 320 / 390 / 1440 and at font scale 1.6.
**Do** pair every overlay's enter with its exit, stay under 300 ms, and give each a reduced-motion fade.
donts: **Don't** put an eyebrow, kicker or small label above a title.
**Don't** use red as decoration, as a category colour or as a brand accent.
**Don't** use the logo lime (#5E8C00 / #C8F03C) anywhere but the logo, favicon and app icon.
**Don't** show "Normal" importance, or give importance its own colour beyond the red Urgent word.
**Don't** nest cards in cards, outline every container, or mark one boundary with both a hairline and a fill.
**Don't** put shadows on content; elevation belongs to sheets, dialogs, popovers, toasts and tooltips.
**Don't** use text glyphs (↵, ⋯) as icons, an outlined square for Stop, or a pulsing running dot.
**Don't** use pill tags or tags with dots; tags are `sm` rectangles.
**Don't** spread the dot grid beyond Day's timeline.
**Don't** use off-scale spacing, radii, font sizes or arbitrary values; the token scales are the only scales.
**Don't** dim disabled controls with opacity, or show state by colour alone.
**Don't** animate list mounts, filter changes or day switches, or pair a fixed timer with an animation.
